_about: Passive tree versioning. Bump tree_version whenever node ids, links, costs or effects change in a way that should reset allocations; saves made with an older tree_version get a FULL free refund on load (Dan, 2026-11-04). history[N] lists what changed going from version N-1 to N: removed or renamed ids as old_id -> new_id (or null when removed). Allocations are not remapped (always full refund); the map exists so build codes and presets can be translated, and the validator checks it. Never reuse an id.
